text_en: By the rivers of Babylon— there we sat down and there we wept when we remembered Zion.
text_cn: 当我们坐在巴比伦河畔， 一想起熙雍即泪流满面。

text_en: On the willows there we hung up our harps.
text_cn: 在那地的杨柳间， 挂起我们的琴弦。

text_en: For there our captors asked us for songs, and our tormentors asked for mirth, saying, “Sing us one of the songs of Zion! ”
text_cn: 因那些俘虏我们的，要我们唱歌， 那些迫害我们的，还要我们奏乐： 快些来给我们唱一支熙雍的歌！

text_en: How could we sing the Lord ’s song in a foreign land?
text_cn: 但我们身处外乡异域， 怎能讴唱上主的歌曲？

text_en: If I forget you, O Jerusalem, let my right hand wither!
text_cn: 耶路撒冷！我如果将你忘掉，愿我的右手枯焦！

text_en: Let my tongue cling to the roof of my mouth, if I do not remember you, if I do not set Jerusalem above my highest joy.
text_cn: 我若不怀念你，不以耶路撒冷为喜乐， 就宁愿我的舌头紧紧贴在我的上颚！

text_en: Remember, O Lord , against the Edomites the day of Jerusalem’s fall, how they said, “Tear it down! Tear it down! Down to its foundations! ”
text_cn: 上主，求你要记住厄东的子民， 在耶路撒冷蒙难的时辰， 他们曾喊叫说：拆毁，拆毁！ 夷为平地，一直见到基础，

text_en: O daughter Babylon, you devastator! Happy shall they be who pay you back what you have done to us!
text_cn: 你这只知破坏的巴比伦女子！ 谁若依照你加给我们的灾痍， 也照样报复于你，他就得福祺。

text_en: Happy shall they be who take your little ones and dash them against the rock!
text_cn: 谁若抓起你的婴儿幼子， 摔在磐石上，他就得福祺！
